description.value:
“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says ‘stop.’”

Human (Cro-Magnon). You are not a fantasy human. You are the cognitive, symbolic, cooperative inheritance of the lineage that first painted ancestors on cave walls, buried its dead with flowers, and traded ochre across a continent it had no map for.

Where Neanderthal is strength and Florensis is reach, Cro-Magnon is pattern. Language, ritual, coalition. You are the human branch that kept explaining things until the explanation started working.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.

  • Size. Medium.

  • Speed. 6 squares

  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward MND (Mind) or PRE (Presence)—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Stubborn Spark

At creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory).

Cro-Magnon Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Cro-Magnon powers emphasize: Symbolic Thought (ritual and language sensitivity), Coalition Instinct (when you Help an ally, they also shed 1 Stress), Tool Mind (improvisational tool use), and Narrative Memory (lore retention that persists across generations).

Domain Edge

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Intrigue marks and +20 Soft Power marks at campaign start.

description.value:
"You're not the hero. You're the reason the heroes don't trip over each other."

The Harmony Marshal runs on Surge like everyone — but yours arrives sideways: when an ally within 6 squares lands a surging roll (an exploding 10), the brilliance resonates into you and you bank a Surge too (+1, max +2/round). The party's best moments are your fuel; you spend them feeding the party back. Your tier powers are Surge spends, and the rerolls auto-fire now — no GM bookkeeping:

The Mandate (spent via Surge)

  • Rallying Words (1) — an ally banks a reroll-lowest on their next roll.
  • Ease Attrition (2) — heal an ally and clear one condition.
  • Rally to Me (2) — an ally banks a reroll and frees a reaction.
  • Unity Flourish (3) — every ally within 6 squares banks a reroll.
  • Conductor's Crescendo (5) — the whole line banks a reroll and each clears a condition.

The strategic layer endures out of combat — Attrition Easer, Loyalty Steward, and Unity Conductor still move Soft Power, attrition, and hex loyalty on the campaign turn. In a fight, though, you are a reroll engine: the dice obey you because you asked nicely, at exactly the right moment.

Harmony Initiate. You are a designated Harmony asset for your Domain.

  • You gain a skill rank in Diplomacy (Presence) and Insight (Soul) (handled by the Harmony Marshal class traits).
  • When you are the active Harmony Marshal for a Domain, that Domain’s Soft Power generation increases by 10% (rounding in your favor). The GM can apply this as a +10% modifier or as a small bonus whenever it would meaningfully matter for the current campaign scale.
  • This feature is Bad Eden-only and interacts with your Domain sheet’s Soft Power channel.

Silver Tongue Protocol. You have rehearsed, iterated, and field-tested the art of getting people to actually talk.

  • Whenever you make a Diplomacy (Presence) or Stealth (Intrigue) check, you can treat a rolled result of 8 or lower on the 2d10 as a 9 instead. You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your Presence value (minimum once).
  • In Parley, you can spend one use of this feature to reroll the lowest die on a single Influence roll.

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Diplomacy (Presence) and Stealth (Intrigue) checks as a quality-of-life bonus.)

Peacekeeper's Poise. Your presence steadies people at the exact moment everything could go sideways.

  • When initiative is rolled, you can choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Presence value (minimum one) within 6 squares of you. Each gains temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value + your tier.
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

description.value:
"Nothing unobserved."

Mode: Tactical discipline

Overwatch is the Marshal who already saw the ambush and is faintly bored by it. Your Surge spends are reactive armor — covering allies the instant they're threatened, countering the enemy's tricks, and drawing a line nobody crosses for free.

Doctrine (spent via Surge)

  • Covered (1) — an ally gains DR equal to your tier this round (the Network has them).
  • Counter-Discord (2) — strip a debuff off an ally and hand them a reroll. The lie stops working.
  • Locked Perimeter (4) — allies within 6 squares gain DR. Hold the ground.

Out-of-combat: the per-use Jam the Signal reaction (cancel a deceit-based penalty within 12 squares) and Signal Boost, Rally Net, Chorus of the People and the Sentinel Protocol remain the strategic flourishes.

Rallying Speech. You can deliver a short, targeted speech that makes people remember why you’re here.

  • As a bonus action, choose one creature other than yourself within 6 squares who can see or hear you. That creature gains a bonus to the next attack roll, attribute check, or defense check it makes before the start of your next turn. The bonus equals your Presence value (minimum +1).
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

Read the Room. You have an instinctive feel for the emotional geometry of conversations.

  • When you make an Insight (Soul) or Perception (Mind) check to gauge mood, detect Stealth, or sense the underlying stakes of a scene, you can add a d4 to the roll.
  • You can use this feature after you roll but before the GM tells you whether you succeed. Uses per Soma Break equal to your Soul value (minimum once).

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Insight (Soul) and Perception (Mind) checks.)

Anchor Point

The world pushes. You remain.

Rules

You reroll the lowest die on checks or saves made to resist being pushed, pulled, knocked prone, Shaken, or charmed.

⚙ Reroll-lowest on checks and defense checks; the push / pull / prone / Shaken / charm gate is read by the GM.

description.value:
Your vantage is systems-level; your voice, the signal.

When an ally within 6 squares makes a key roll directly tied to the current objective (attack on a critical target, clutch save, investigation breakthrough, negotiation pivot), you may use your reaction to steady the moment.

  • The ally adds your tier to the roll.
  • You may use this feature a number of times equal to your tier, regaining all uses on a Soma Break.

Strategic Layer. When you lead a diplomatic, social, or morale-driven scenario, the first Soft Power spend your Domain makes during that scenario is reduced by 10 marks (minimum 10). This can occur once per scenario you lead.

activation.condition: Ally within 30 ft makes a key roll.

description.value:
You elevate a single voice until it carries a whole room.

As a bonus action, choose one ally within 12 squares who can hear you. Until the start of your next turn:

  • The ally rerolls the lowest die on their next Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) check.
  • If that check shifts a crowd, faction representative, or social tempo, your Domain gains +10 Soft Power marks for the next turn (once per scene).

This represents you turning someone into the right voice at the right time.

description.value:
Breach Specialist

Everything has a seam. Most people just don’t look.

Rules

You gain a rank in Tinkering. If you already have it, its rank rises by one instead.

When you hit an object, door, barrier, or construct with a weapon attack, you may treat the attack as dealing maximum damage to the target’s objects-only resistances (GM adjudication). Once you do, you can’t do so again until the start of your next turn.

⚙ +1 Tinkering. 🃏 Card — the max-damage-vs-objects rider, once per round.

Attrition Easer. Once per turn, during your Domain’s planning phase, you may spend 10 Soft Power marks to remove 1 point of Attrition from your Domain, to a minimum of 0. This represents rest cycles, counseling, conflict resolution, and the very boring but vital work of actually processing the trauma.

Unity Field. Your conviction radiates outward like a stabilizing field.

  • While you are conscious, you emit a 2 squares aura. Allies in the aura (including you) reroll the lowest die on defense checks against being charmed or Shaken.
  • Once per turn when a creature starts its turn in your aura, you can grant it temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value (no action required).

(The Active Effect marks you as projecting the Unity Field aura; GMs and scripts can key off this flag.)

You silence manipulation mid-note.

When a creature within 12 squares uses a deceit-based tactic—such as imposing a keep-lowest roll through misinformation, illusions, fear propaganda, or a charm-adjacent mental effect—you may use your reaction to nullify that interference.

  • The imposed penalty or forced reroll is canceled.
  • You can use this feature once per Soma Break.

In Bad Eden terms: you jam the signal.

Negotiated Advantage. You can derail a hostile act mid-motion with a word, a look, or a sudden reframing.

  • When a creature you can see within 6 squares makes an attack roll or attribute check against you or an ally, you can use your reaction to impose roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on that roll, as you disrupt the moment with a sharp interjection.
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your Presence value (minimum once).

Bound and Bargained

A sealed pact holds itself; you need only keep the terms.

Rules

While your Sealed Pact stance is active, the bindings carry part of your will for you: your Clarity maximum rises by 1.

Requires: Pactkeeper⚙ Applies automatically while the Sealed Pact stance is active: Clarity max +1.

Crisis Mediator. You specialize in talking people down from the brink.

  • When you resolve a significant scene that could have become a combat encounter (or escalated to violence) using primarily Diplomacy, Performance (Presence), Insight (Soul), or other nonviolent means, you may apply one of the following effects, as appropriate to the fiction:
  • • Darkness –1 in the affected hex or faction (to a campaign-appropriate minimum).
  • • +10 Soft Power marks to your Domain at the end of the turn.

You can apply this feature once per scene, and a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

Your voice becomes a tactical relay.

Allies who can hear you may treat your space as the origin point for any ability they use that requires verbal projection, including:

  • Shouts, commands, speeches
  • Inspiring or intimidating effects
  • Sound-based class features

This allows allies to affect targets they could not normally reach, as long as you are within range of them, even if they are not.

Voice of the Mandate. Your voice now carries not just your own authority, but the weight of your Domain’s mandate.

  • Allies within 6 squares of you who can hear you gain a +1 bonus to defense checks against being Shaken or charmed, and to last stand checks.
  • On the strategic layer, once per turn when you personally participate in a Parley, Battle, Heist, or other opposed Domain operation, you can grant your side a +1 bonus to one opposed roll representing speeches, appeals, or visible leadership.

Crew Type (Bad Eden): Diplomatic Envoys.

“We are here in peace. Don’t make that embarrassing.”

Diplomatic Envoys are the faction’s public face and private threat. They shake hands with one hand and count exits with the other. Their talent is making every negotiation feel like the only sensible outcome was the one they wanted.

  • Tactical Identity: You gain a skill rank in Insight and Diplomacy, and you learn one extra language.
  • Strategic Identity: Your Domain earns +10 Diplomacy marks each turn while you serve it.

“Velocity is not speed. It is direction maintained under pressure.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Chariot (Squad Leader). Field commander, momentum-anchor, and small-unit tactician. You turn chaos into movement and movement into victory.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your Domain earns +10 Violence and +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of squad command, coordinated action, and breach momentum.
